description: This file contains data classes and functions for parsing and handling error messages related to invoke errors within the 'ai.openclaw.app.gateway' package. It defines the ParsedInvokeError data class, along with functions to parse error messages from strings and throwables, facilitating error handling in the application.

classes.name: ParsedInvokeError
classes.description: A data class representing parsed invoke error details, including code, message, and whether an explicit code was provided.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw error message string into a ParsedInvokeError object, identifying error code and message.

methods.name: parseInvokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Extracts and parses an error message from a Throwable object, providing a fallback message if necessary.
